title: ap_status builds media URL with wrong path format
description: activitypub.rs:711-713. The ap_status function builds media URLs as format\!("https://{domain}/media/{}/{}.{}", persona.id, m.id, m.mime_type.split('/').nth(1).unwrap_or("bin")). But the actual media upload path (media.rs:221) stores files as 'media/{hex_prefix}/{id}.{ext}'. The URL format in ap_status doesn't match the file storage format — it uses persona.id as the prefix instead of the hex prefix. Unless there's a separate route handler that maps /media/{persona_id}/{id}.{ext} to the actual file, these URLs will 404. Compare with posting.rs:1407 which correctly uses format\!("https://{domain}/media/{file_path}") using the stored file_path.
